candidates.title: Hybrid LLM: Cost-Efficient and Quality-Aware Query Routing
candidates.reason: ICLR 2024 work on quality-aware routing between small and large models; directly relevant to heterogeneous multi-model serving, edge/cloud inference, and cost-aware request routing, with up to 40% fewer large-model calls reported without quality loss.

candidates.title: Who Says Elephants Can't Run: Bringing Large Scale MoE Models into Cloud Scale Production
candidates.reason: Foundational production-oriented MoE inference optimization work combining sparse-model serving and expert-weight quantization; reports up to 26x throughput speedup and roughly 8x model-size reduction, directly filling the MoE quantization/serving lineage.

candidates.title: LightSeq: A High Performance Inference Library for Sequence Processing and Generation
candidates.reason: Early high-performance Transformer inference library with GPU kernel and memory optimizations; useful historical systems baseline for serving/runtime lineages, reporting up to 14x speedup over TensorFlow and 1.4x over FasterTransformer.
